item.title: Diego Rossi scores late to rally Columbus Crew to 2-2 draw with Sporting Kansas City
item.description: Diego Rossi scored late in the second half to offset a two-goal effort by Dejan Joveljić, rallying the Columbus Crew to a 2-2 draw with Sporting Kansas City.

item.title: Luka Doncic scores 26 points, LeBron James adds 22 as Lakers run away from Warriors for 129-101 win
item.description: Luka Doncic had 26 points, eight assists and six rebounds, LeBron James added 22 points, nine assists and seven rebounds, and the Los Angeles Lakers ran away from the short-handed Golden State Warriors for a 129-101 win.

item.title: Carr scores 26, Agbim hits late FT and Baylor holds off UCF 87-86
item.description: Baylor edges UCF 87-86 after Obi Agbim sinks a late free throw to seal a wild finish.

item.title: No. 7 Florida clinches at least a share of the SEC title with a 111-77 drubbing No. 20 Arkansas
item.description: Thomas Haugh scored 22 points, Rueben Chinyelu added his 17th double-double of the season and No. 7 Florida earned at least a share of the Southeastern Conference title with a resounding, 111-77 drubbing of 20th-ranked Arkansas.

item.title: Brian Schwake has 2 saves for Nashville in 0-0 tie with Dallas
item.description: Brian Schwake had two saves for Nashville SC in a 0-0 tie with FC Dallas.

item.title: Pinkins and Storr score 26 apiece, Ole Miss beats Auburn 85-79 to snap a 10-game skid
item.description: Patton Pinkins made 8 of 10 from the field and finished with a career-high 26 points, AJ Storr also scored 26 points, and Mississippi beat Auburn 85-79 to snap a 10-game skid.

item.title: Henri Veesaar matches a season-high with 26 points to carry No. 18 North Carolina past Virginia Tech
item.description: Henri Veesaar matched a season-high with 26 points, Seth Trimble scored 20 points, and No. 18 North Carolina pulled away in the second half to beat Virginia Tech 89-82.

item.title: Robertson's overtime goal caps Stars' 3-2 comeback over Predators for 8th straight win
item.description: Jason Robertson scored in overtime as the Dallas Stars rally past the Nashville Predators 3-2 for their eighth straight win.

item.title: A title chase in Australia, and the off-field dispute South Korea wants left behind
item.description: Shin Sang-woo's South Korea squad needs to overcome off-field obstacles to win the Women's Asian Cup for the first time.

item.title: Mark Delgado, Son Heung-min, Hugo Lloris lead LAFC to 2-0 victory over Dynamo
item.description: Mark Delgado had a goal and an assist, Son Heung-min had two assists and Hugo Lloris posted a second straight clean sheet to help Los Angeles FC beat Houston 2-0 after the Dynamo lost two players to red cards.
